## Professional Experience & Achievements

- [Techmile (Insuremile)](https://raheem.page/): Leading Java microservices upgrade from JDK 8 to JDK 17, building Python automation scripts, and integrating Azure Cosmos DB with API Gateway.
- [Ignite3i](https://raheem.page/): Engineered binary log-code decoding system for tower fault detection, built 10+ RESTful APIs across 5-service insurance microservices architecture, and migrated databases to Azure SQL.

## Key Projects

- [Phishing URL Detection System](https://github.com/Raheem02/minimal-portfolio): Multi-signal machine learning pipeline processing 1.3M URLs with LightGBM and Random Forest (97% ROC-AUC) paired with FastAPI real-time inference.
- [Learn with AR Platform](https://github.com/Raheem02/minimal-portfolio): KSCST-funded Android AR educational application built with Unity 3D and ARCore across 8 interactive modules.
- [Insurance Management System](https://raheem.page/): Multi-platform policy administration system handling claims processing and customer management with JWT security.
